{{Quote|Warfare is the product of cowardice; it takes bravery to forego easy answers and find peaceful resolutions.|Padmé Amidala speaks at the Peace Rally|<ref name="HNN" />}}
A '''Peace Rally on Commenor''' was held during<ref name="HNN" /> the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], when heightening tensions between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] threatened the [[Great Peace of the Republic|era of peace]] that lasted for almost a [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]].<ref name="CSWE Great Peace">{{CSWECite|I|363|Great Peace of the Republic}}</ref> Republic [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] spoke at the rally to a gathering of [[University of Commenor]] students. A part of [[Gender/Legends|her]] inter-[[Planet/Legends|planetary]] series of speeches in support of the [[Campaign against Republic Militarization]], Amidala stated warfare was a product of cowardice, and further said that bravery was to let go of the easy, violent path, and instead engage in peaceful negotiations.<ref name="HNN" />

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Amidala's remarks were publicly criticized by the [[Stark Veteran Assembly]] in a live interview on the [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]-based talk show, ''[[Essence]]'', where Assembly Spokesbeing [[Laslo Dorits]] called Amidala's statement "disgraceful, stupid and typical." Following criticism of her [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] rally speech, Padmé Amidala posted a statement at the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet's]] [[Naboo message exchange]], saying that she had great respect for defenders of their native soil, and that she too had a [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|taste of war]] that she would never forget. Amidala then went on to say that "needless warmongering of the type being conducted by alarmist elements in the Senate" was what she did not respect.<ref name="HNN" /> Nonetheless, [[Clone Wars/Legends|war]] later [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|erupted]], and the era of general [[The galaxy|galactic]] peace came to an end.<ref name="CSWE Great Peace" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Peace Rally on Commenor appears via hologram in ''[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 #45]]''.<ref name="HNN" />
